commit.message:
feat: run all-3530 MS page locator backfill and produce blocker map (#1489)

Run the merged #1488 deterministic MS page-locator harness across all 3530
governed 9709 rows and materialise the runtime locator inventory v2, blocker
map, and readback.

- New build script re-runs the #1488 harness in-process (validator must pass),
  then re-shapes rows into a multi-page-aware inventory with ms_page_range and
  located_pages roles (target_start/target_continuation/neighbor_context).
- Preserves all 3530 rows; duplicate_question_key_count=0; missing_ms explicitly
  counted (0). Reports document_only_count_after_backfill (1563),
  page_or_exact_located_count_after_backfill (635), same-page exposure (490) /
  warning-missing (0), cross_page_row_count (32), located_page_count (693)
  separate from located_row_count (635).
- Does not force guesses: single-page rows whose continuation cannot be
  deterministically bounded become needs_manual_review (274) instead of being
  truncated; ambiguous page/document evidence is preserved.
- page/exact coverage 17.99% < 95% -> launch_readiness_locator_gate=blocked with
  exact blocker reasons and per-row/page/document IDs in the blocker map.
- document_only_student_reveal_allowed_count=0. No screenshots, OCR/VLM, external
  model calls, Supabase/RAG/vector mutations (side_effect_receipt all zero).

Artifacts:
- artifacts/method-map/v1-9709/post-attempt-ms-page-locator-backfill-all-3530.v1.json
- artifacts/method-map/v1-9709/post-attempt-ms-page-locator-backfill-all-3530.validator-result.v1.json
- artifacts/method-map/v1-9709/post-attempt-ms-page-locator-backfill-blocker-map.v1.json
- artifacts/method-map/v1-9709/post-attempt-ms-page-locator-backfill.readback.md
